blocks.text: Translation, yaani protein banane, mein mRNA ki maloomat se polypeptide mein amino acids ki tarteeb tay hoti hai. Yeh ribosomes par hota hai aur is ke liye mRNA, amino acids le jane wale tRNAs, aur enzymes aur factors chahiye.

items: Amino acids ki activation: har amino acid apne tRNA se jurta hai.
Initiation: ribosome, mRNA aur pehla tRNA ikatthe hote hain.
Elongation: har codon par aik amino acid jurta hai.
Termination: stop codon zanjeer khatam karta hai.

blocks.prompt: Translation kya banata hai, aur kis maloomat se?
blocks.explanation: Polypeptide, mRNA ke codons ke silsile se.

items: Translation: ribosomes par mRNA codons amino acids ki tarteeb tay karte hain.
